story_clusters.headline: Karnataka Cabinet expansion | Facing heat, Congress weighs changes to ministerial line-up
story_clusters.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet is undergoing an expansion, with the Congress party facing internal pressure to adjust its ministerial lineup. The BJP has alleged opposition within Congress to B Nagendra's induction and accused the party of including "corrupt leaders" in the expansion. Supporters of excluded Congress leaders have taken to the streets in protest.
